hook.head: How I find website clients with AI.
hook.vo: Here's how I find website clients, using AI.

tips.vo: Pick one type of business, like cafés. Every café needs the same things: a menu, a map, and a way to order.
tips.head: Pick one niche.

tips.n: Step two. Build a free sample.
tips.vo: Before you pitch, build a free sample with their real menu. People say yes to something they can see, not to a promise.
tips.head: Build a free sample.

tips.vo: Message them with one specific compliment about their page, then offer the sample. No copy and paste spam.
tips.head: Send a real message.

msgs: Your pistachio latte reel was so good. I made you a free website sample, want to see it?

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
